The main takeaway from our work is that
intra-articular calcaneous fractures are a high-risk fracture for tendon dislocation and should be evaluated with intraoperative retinal testing in addition to preoperative imaging.

peroneal tendon subluxation is a common injury associated with intra-articular calcaneous fracture and that the incidence of tendon instability is higher on preoperative imaging than intraoperative assessment.
peroneal tendon injury should be suspected in all intra-articular calcaneous fractures, and the tendon should be directly visualized and tested intraoperatively.
